label: MIDI Filter
comment: Steers MIDI between plugins: keeps one channel or all, moves what it keeps to another channel, transposes notes, and passes only the notes inside a range, so two of them split a keyboard between two instruments. A note-off passes only for a note-on that passed, so nothing is left sustaining when a setting changes mid-note.
cautions: Declares no jig:module and so no jig:abi. A host that loads a module directly, such as the native adapter, cannot load this plugin; a JavaScript AudioWorklet host can.
Only the note range and transpose touch notes. Control changes, pitch bend and other channel messages follow the channel settings alone, and system messages always pass.

ports.name: Send on channel (0 = as it came)
